templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from phase-lanes by the note-writer: this is a 4-component control-loop diagram, EnvManager cycling Reset/Action with a self-loop arrow among Reward Worker, LLM Proxy, and Inference Worker; nothing sits along a time axis and there are no lanes.
templates.what_to_learn: Read this as a small control-loop or hub figure instead: a self-loop arrow on EnvManager marks its per-instance reset, and the stacked-rectangle icon reused on every box signals many parallel trajectory instances without needing a time axis or lane grid at all.

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from multi-tier by the note-writer: four same-level worker boxes in one row, each marked with a stacked-card icon for many parallel instances; there is no tier stack or network boundary, so this is pipeline/replicated-grid, not multi-tier.
templates.what_to_learn: Reuse one small stacked-rectangle icon on every box in a row to say 'this runs as many parallel instances' without redrawing each copy, and give a self-looping component (here EnvManager's Reset) its own tight loop-back arrow rather than routing it across the whole diagram.
